reviews.x: Amazing. I just did my first Dead Sea Facial Mask from Aspens and the whole experience was luxurious. The product is so smooth and refreshing. The consistency is unlike any other face mask I've tried--it felt cool, light, loving, silky, rich and hydrating. I used like one-quarter of what I would normally use of another mask to cover my face so it looks like a HUGE bang for my buck. Organic, homemade, lasts longer--phenomenal. I will never go back to other brands. Thank you for taking great care

This is nice natural mud mask. I didn't experience any burning having it on, or mask residue after washing it off my face. It does have essential oils. So, you will smell some lavender, but it doesn't bother me, since I'm used to the smell. I use this twice a week for soft skin, shrinking pores, and to look refresh. Don't be caught off guard. It's a small jar, but a lot of the product within the container. Great consistency and even out smooth on the face. You can tell the difference between thi

I received this two days after I ordered it. The instructions on use are very clear and simple. I can feel the product working while it's on my skin. When I washed it off my face my pores were spotless and my skin was so soft. I really enjoyed the scent of the natural oils. I will continue to use this product a couple of times a week. I am so happy I found this!!!

Oh my god this stuff is heaven in a jar! It smells wonderful ( just a hint of lavender) but it doesn't burn me or give me a headache. It feels buttery on my skin and if you rub it off once it's dry it exfoliates so well. I typically have very sensitive skin but this stuff is so gentle and pleasant. I'm buying another jar right now!

reviews.t: NOT for sensitive or combination skin
reviews.x: I have combination skin and after only 8 min my skin was on "fire". I had to use very cold water to calm it down. Will not buy again and i would like my money back preferably. I knew buying mud was a crazy idea, but I thought I might be the crazy one for not to give it a try with all the glowing reviews. Never again.
I didn't realize that the jar was small. Seems to be working well. Just wish it was a bigger container for the money.

reviews.t: Great for Acne, But Does Smell a little Funky
reviews.x: This mask is nice and thick, doesn't flake off while you're sitting there letting it sink in. I also love the color of the mask--dark deep gray almost black. Other mud masks are boring gray, so I like the deeper color. The results are great--it's really helping keep my mild acne in check. The only thing is that it smells a little funky--the strong lavender smell is initially nice but underneath that smell is a really funky earthy mud smell (it is mud!) that is slightly unpleasant for me since I

reviews.t: Nice mud mask that leaves skin feeling clean and smooth
reviews.x: Having never used a mud mask before, I'm not sure what I expected, but this product seemed to do what I would have thought one might. I originally ordered this mud mask for my husband as he had a skin condition on his hand. In the meantime, he got another product for it that was already working, so when it arrived I ended up using it as a face mask, which is probably what it is most often used for anyhow. It seemed to tighten my skin and refresh it, and my face felt clean and invigorated afterwa

This mask is great! I got it earlier than expected. It is a dark color mask with a strong smell of lavender. After putting a thin layer on my face, I started to feel it harden after just  few minutes. I usually leave it on for about 15 minutes. Once you wash it off, it leaves the face very very soft. It is great!!! I have a combination skin and have had no problems so far.

I have a compulsive shopping problem when it comes to skin products. I've tried so many products, but I LOVE this mask. My skin feels so clean and so soft after I use it. I will actually buy this again (instead of tossing it in the back of my bathroom shelf). I also like the soap bars that I ordered from Aspen Kay so I am sticking with their products now.

I have combination dry and oily skin.  Dry on my chin to the point of red & flakey.  My usual combination of Aztec clay + apple cider vinegar was proving too drying for my skin so i tried the dead sea mask.  This mask is wonderfully moistruizing!  It makes my skin feel so silky and clean.  I'll buy again.

I liked this mud mask as it didn't make my face feel tight and uncomfortable.  It was easy to wash off and I felt my nasal passages open up.  It was pretty refreshing.  I like pampering myself with this kind of stuff and I wasn't disappointed. My skin felt great.

Immediately after using the mask, my face felt smoother and tighter.  I highly recommend this product.  Only con would be that the smell which isn't too bad once it begins to dry.  The smell is like an earthy dirt smell which makes sense.  Again, well worth it.

I should use this mask more often. It smells amazing. I've been using it every week and a half or so. Actually, due to the slight grit in the formula, it does somewhat exfoliate as you take it off. It always leaves my face super soft. I will repurchase!

I've tried many masks before...this one takes the cake.  I love how it feels going on, and also how refreshed my skin feels afterwards!  The smell is amazing - smells mostly like lavender to me.  Love the ingredients, too!  Highly recommend it.

reviews.t: I've already tried it and love it! I haven't used a pack in years ...
reviews.x: I've already tried it and love it! I haven't used a pack in years and they are much improved. I didn't look like a gargoyle when I looked in the mirror and it didn't flake all over the place. The smell I can put up with. Good job! And thanks.

Love this, it's not gritty, applies smooth, smells nice and left my skin feeling super soft. I had a blemish on my hair line that was tender to the touch and almost non existent after applying this mask to it. Loving the ingredients as well!

I really love this mask. It goes on so nice and is so easy to take off. It leaves my skin so soft. I highly recommend this product. It is one of the best masks I have used. I have used many. Give it a try, I am sure you will love it too. B

Im fairly certain that the shea butter in this made me break out, as that is bad for people with acne.  It doesnt wash off well and smells a little odd. The shipping and size of the product were fine but the actually item was lackluster.

reviews.t: This is a terrific mask. I have problematic skin and have used ...
reviews.x: This is a terrific mask. I have problematic skin and have used this a couple of times and it has already made a difference. I am aways looking for the perfect mask and I have finally found it. Added bonus is that it smells delightful!!

reviews.t: Excellent mask for all skin types.
reviews.x: Love this brand!! I have multiple bars of their dead sea mineral mud soap, so I felt compelled to try their Mud Mask. Works like a charm. Isn't to drying, and did not cause any reactions to my very sensitive skin. Excellent product.

reviews.t: Totally in love with this product
reviews.x: Used once so far, and I have already received compliments that my skin looked brighter, more refreshed. I had a small breakout on my jaw line and I could feel this working. Totally in love with this product :-)

reviews.t: I am delighted with this mask
reviews.x: I am delighted with this mask.  It does a great job cleansing and exfoliating my skin, and the price is reasonable as well.  Thank you for good service and an effective mask that is 100% organic.  I love it!

reviews.t: Wonderful organic dead sea mud mask!
reviews.x: This is a fantastic product! I have the most sensitive skin and the Mud Mask treats it like a goddess! It is so beautifully fragrant and rich, you can feel and see the difference after you have it on.
Used this for the first time tonight.  I have very sensitive skin and I really, really like this mask.  My skin felt soft and smooth.  Excellent ingredients.  Definitely recommend!

claims.text: Reviewers frequently say the mask leaves skin soft, smooth, and clean after use.
Many reviewers enjoy the scent, often describing it as lavender or natural oils, though a few find it strong or earthy.
Several reviewers describe the mask as gentle, moisturizing, and non-drying, with some noting it doesn't make skin feel tight.
A few reviewers mention the container is small for the price.
One reviewer with combination skin reports burning and irritation, saying it is not for sensitive or combination skin.
